description: Search the Code of Alabama 1975 BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "landlord security deposit", "concealed pistol permit", "homicide". This is a REAL FULL-TEXT search over actual section body text (not just captions) run live against the Alabama Legislature's own search index — confirmed to surface sections whose title never mentions the search term. Returns matching citations, titles and a text snippet; call al_statute with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".

name: al_search
